rules.options_main: Options on Monday, Wednesday and Friday on the board as he first saw it (ideas.json days).
rules.options_off: Off-day options on the board, the weekly good news left out (ideas.json offdays).
rules.pressed_share: Share of all options with a final press of his (any of the five outcomes). Under 0.8 is flagged: pressing less never passes for success.
rules.picks: His Approve on a publishing day, as it stood at the end (his last pick of each day).
rules.picks_as_written: Picks on which nothing he said (the pick's note or any other press on that option) asks to reframe it, deepen it or say it simpler (idea_checks.PART_WORDS).
rules.rank1_picked: Picks that were the first option of their day (the one the board led with).
rules.wasted_presses: Presses (his last on each option, and his words on a pick) that are a Reject worded as refusing or repeating (boring, lame, no point, don't understand; told you, I just said), or that ask for research, depth or simpler words. The 10x number: target at most 1 a board.
rules.wasted_without_pick_depth: The same, leaving out depth or simpler asks made on a pick.
rules.main_rejects: Final Reject (not for us, a Drop) on a publishing day's option.
rules.main_rejects_with_curious: Main rejects plus a "curious" verdict whose words refuse (19 Oct triage only).
rules.offday_rejects_refusing: Off-day options he rejected in refusing words (boring, lame, no point, don't understand).
rules.refused_subject_options: Options on a subject he refused before the board (idea_checks.refused_findings: refused or warned).
rules.big_question: A publishing day's option is a big question when the first sentence of what it says (so_what) names no company, product, person or study; otherwise it is one event. Counted for options and for picks.
rules.asks_as_typed: An option answers his ask as typed when it covers the ask and carries his typed words whole (in its from line, so_what or story). Counted for options and for picks.
rules.minutes: His pressing time on the board: from his first press to his last in each sitting (a gap over 60 minutes starts a new sitting), summed.
